BiblicalUsage: Belteshazzar means "lord of the straitened's treasure." It was the Babylonian name given to Daniel. You will find it in Daniel 2:26, Daniel 4:8 and Daniel 4:9.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God lets His servant carry a foreign name without losing who he is. Daniel stays Daniel, whatever Babylon calls him.
